note: What each citation was checked against, and why an unreviewed one was kept. This used to print in the reference list, where a reader met our working notes instead of a bibliography and one entry admitted its source had not been read in full. The record is kept because a verification nobody can see is not a verification; the reference list is not where a reader looks for it.

notes.doosterlinck2024incontext: {PREPRINT}, not peer reviewed. arXiv:2401.12178, v1 only, no Comments and no journal reference
notes.metz2012baselines: Crossref types LNCS proceedings as book-chapter by convention; the container title is the IBERAMIA 2012 proceedings
notes.ng2014conll: Cited with the BEA-2019 shared task for the $F_{0.5}$ convention, which weights precision twice recall to penalise over-correction. The convention is documented by the shared tasks themselves
notes.welleck2019unlikelihood: arXiv:1908.04319. Welleck et al.\ blame the likelihood objective itself; the training-data account is the other paper's
notes.li2023repetition: arXiv:2310.10226. Argues that self-reinforcement explanations reduce to the training-data account
notes.dev2026judge: arXiv:2603.05399. Corrected: this paper does not establish the duplicate- item practice an earlier draft cited it for; it perturbs formatting, paraphrase, verbosity and labels
notes.llamacpp8634: {PREPRINT}, not peer reviewed. ggml-org/llama.cpp issue \#8634. Search result; the issue has not been read in full. Cited with the vllm issue to demote our own mechanism to a known integration wart, which is the conservative direction
notes.kumaran2026confidence: {PREPRINT}, not peer reviewed. arXiv:2606.29490, submitted 2026-06-28 and revised 2026-08-24. Verified against the arXiv listing and the export API on 2026-08-24: a single author rather than the ``et al.'' an internal note had recorded, no Comments field, no journal reference and no {DOI} beyond the arXiv one. Eight models over two classes, with the contrast that carries the claim being verbal confidence against calibrated token log-probabilities
notes.ryan2026attck: {PREPRINT}, not peer reviewed. arXiv:2606.18166. The quoted correlation is from the full text, not the abstract: ``the Spearman rank correlation confirms a statistically significant relationship between parameter size and $F_1$ scores in this CTI classification task ($\rho$=0.85, p=0.014)''
notes.sun2025length: Finding 3: under strict output constraints reasoning performance ``might not scale monotonically with the model size''. Finding 4 independently covers our reasoning-flag confound: reasoning models do not always outperform instruction-tuned ones under the same constraint
notes.gunawi2008eio: Measures error loss at module boundaries: 1153 of 9022 propagation channels (13\%) drop an error code without handling it, and inter-module calls are a major cause
notes.yuan2014simple: An error handler that only logs the error is counted as ignoring it; 25\% of catastrophic failures arise that way, and 92\% from incorrect handling of errors that were explicitly signalled
notes.alquraan2018partition: ``The majority of the failures were silent'', and where a warning was returned ``all returned warnings were confusing, with no clear mechanism for resolution''
notes.xue2025agentbugs: 1026 bugs across LangChain, LlamaIndex and Haystack; nine root causes and six symptom categories
notes.liu2026inference: 929 bugs across llama.cpp, vLLM and four other engines; the taxonomy carries both ``Incorrect Request Parsing'' as a root cause and ``Silent Error'' as a symptom
notes.xu2013misconfig: Names the failure mode: ``silent overruling refers to the case that the system changes an unacceptable user setting into the default value without notifying the user'', measured across 74 parameters in Squid and Apache
notes.oyelayo2026mcp: Bug reports and pull requests on MCP reference servers: data validation and type issues are the second most prevalent class at 13.97\%
notes.martinlopez2019deps: Across 40 APIs and over 2500 operations, input dependencies are ``the norm, rather than the exception, with 85\% of the reviewed APIs'' having them, and OpenAPI cannot express them
notes.mizrahi2024multiprompt: 6.5M instances over 20 models and 39 tasks: ``different instruction templates lead to very different performance, both absolute and relative'', and the relative part is the ranking
notes.jin2024steplength: Cited as the counterweight: lengthening reasoning steps ``considerably enhances LLMs' reasoning abilities''. Read with Sun et al., the effect is task- and budget-dependent rather than monotone in either direction
notes.snell2025testtime: Oral. ``In a FLOPs-matched evaluation, we find that on problems where a smaller base model attains somewhat non-trivial success rates, test-time compute can be used to outperform a 14x larger model''
notes.hassid2024budget: The ranking flips and flips back on an inference-time choice alone: repeated small-model sampling gains up to 15\% with a unit-test oracle, and loses to a single large-model output without one
notes.ttpdetect2026: {PREPRINT}, not peer reviewed. TTPDetect. arXiv:2602.06325. Kept because it is the nearest system to ours and the sentence citing it concedes ground rather than claims it; dropping it for want of a venue would let this paper imply it holds that ground itself. No peer-reviewed system with the same scope was found
notes.metz2015comparing: {PREPRINT}, not peer reviewed. arXiv:1503.06952, v1 only, no venue. Kept for its systematic-review finding rather than for the requirement itself, which now rests on the reviewed IBERAMIA 2012 paper by the same group
notes.tran2026single: {PREPRINT}, not peer reviewed. arXiv:2604.02460. Kept because it says our null is not the first of its kind, and because the crossover figure it reports for our own model class has no reviewed equivalent we could verify. Bertalani{\v c} and Fortuna reach the same conclusion in a reviewed venue
notes.cheng2026ttprint: {PREPRINT}, not peer reviewed. arXiv:2605.25836; the Comments field says so in as many words. Kept because its evidence-grounding requirement is the design constraint our own gate obeys, so dropping it would let us appear to have set that bar ourselves
notes.li2025phishdebate: arXiv:2506.15656. The published citation is given in the arXiv Comments field
notes.kate2025longfunceval: {PREPRINT}, not peer reviewed. arXiv:2505.10570, v1 only, no Comments and no journal reference. Kept because it says the tool-catalogue degradation we report is already documented in general, which is the direction that costs us
notes.chen2025recopilot: {PREPRINT}, not peer reviewed. arXiv:2505.16366, v1 only, no Comments and no journal reference. Cited only as one of the open-weight binary specialists that establish the model-tier split
notes.paramanayakam2025lessismore: arXiv:2411.15399. Both quoted figures were confirmed against the full text
notes.release2026artefact: The repository is the only place the system carries a name. The paper does not: it calls the object of study the pipeline throughout, and a check refuses that name anywhere but this entry
